header_semantics: actual ActiveStream.encodeHeaders entry logger before actual downstreamTiming/codec invocation; independent decoded client response proves eventual delivery, not kernel send timestamp
body_semantics: actual ActiveStream.encodeData entry bytecount/end_stream before addBytesSent and codec invocation
release_semantics: actual DownstreamEnd access log before destroyFilters/deferredDelete; callback bound, not exact allocator free/kernel timestamp
clock_contract: actual logger timestamps carry timezone offset and millisecond truncation; [logged_ms,logged_ms+1ms) interval, no guessed epoch conversion

extproc_logger.semantics: genuine host gRPC close/destroy/attempt callbacks are separate; no gRPCstatus inferred from close log lacking status

logger_tags.scope: actual stream ConnectionId and StreamId tags; single controlled decoded URI nonce disambiguates host stream, never equal-looking native/runtime IDs
